plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.36 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a very confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = at least 2.4 mag is very red, like T-type brown dwarfs.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a T3 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (T5) fits clearly worse.
